Class Result<T>

java.lang.Object
com.qm.bupt.util.Result<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Result<T> extends Object implements Serializable
Unified API response wrapper for frontend-backend communication.

All servlet endpoints return data wrapped in this class, providing a consistent JSON structure with status code, message, and payload fields. Static factory methods create success and error responses.
